known_limitations: Uses in-memory storage, so data is not persisted across restarts.
Implements only a subset of the full requirements, focusing on core record, enrollment, invoice, search, and archive workflows.
Does not implement external integrations such as email, accounting, SMS, calendar, or payment processors.
Does not implement full concurrency control, autosave drafts, import tooling, MFA, or audit log UIs beyond basic history fields.
